description: A high rise building is buying two types of furnaces, a new model and an old model. A new model furnace can heat 10 apartments and consumes 200 kWh per day. An old model can heat 15 apartments and consumes 250 kWh per day. Since the old model is harder to find, at most 35% of the furnaces can be the old model and at least 5 new model furnaces should be used. If the high rise needs to heat at least 200 apartments and has 3500 kWh of electricity available, how many of each furnace should be purchase to minimize the total number of furnaces?

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of furnaces purchased (new and old combined)"

constraints.description: The total heating capacity provided by new and old furnaces must be at least the minimum heating requirement
The total energy consumption of new and old furnaces must not exceed the available energy
The number of old model furnaces must be at most 35% of the total number of furnaces purchased
The number of new model furnaces must be at least the minimum required number of new furnaces
The number of old model furnaces must be non-negative

NewFurnaces.definition: Number of new model furnaces to purchase

OldFurnaces.definition: Number of old model furnaces to purchase
